surface.note: Independent review (GateReview) found two gate defects and three prose items. Both defects fixed and proven as c6/c7 with their own RED->GREEN->SURFACE. Prose items applied: the render mechanisms were restated correctly (frontmatter draws as a rule plus a setext heading, not literal text; [!NOTE] draws as a quote), the unevidenced 'user can tick them' interactivity claim was dropped, and the duplicated always-pair was cut so the file carries only the two unguessable constraints plus the plain-language lead. Both test gaps the reviewer named are closed by the c6 and c7 tests. Final: 59 bun pass, 25 shell assertions pass.
